sqlMap.insert:
INSERT INTO land_info (pnu, administrative_district, issan, bon, bu, jimok_cd, jimok, area, land_move_reason_cd, land_move_reason, land_move_date , soyu_address, soyu_name, soyu_cd, soyu_gubun, soyu_trans_date, soyu_trans_reason_cd, soyu_trans_reason, sharing_num, pnilp, pnlip_susi, pnlip_1y_ago, pnlip_1y_ago_susi, pnlip_2y_ago, pnlip_2y_ago_susi, pnlip_3y_ago, pnlip_3y_ago_susi, pnlip_4y_ago, pnlip_4y_ago_susi,insert_date) VALUES
( #[].pnu#, #[].administrative_district#, #[].issan#, #[].bon#, #[].bu#, #[].jimok_cd#, #[].jimok#, #[].area#, #[].land_move_reason_cd#, #[].land_move_reason#, #[].land_move_date#, #[].soyu_address#, #[].soyu_name#, #[].soyu_cd#, #[].soyu_gubun#, #[].soyu_trans_date#, #[].soyu_trans_reason_cd#, #[].soyu_trans_reason#, #[].sharing_num#, #[].pnilp#, #[].pnlip_susi#, #[].pnlip_1y_ago#, #[].pnlip_1y_ago_susi#, #[].pnlip_2y_ago#, #[].pnlip_2y_ago_susi#, #[].pnlip_3y_ago#, #[].pnlip_3y_ago_susi#, #[].pnlip_4y_ago#, #[].pnlip_4y_ago_susi#, now() )
sqlMap.delete: DELETE FROM land_info WHERE land_key IN ( select land_key FROM ( SELECT land_key , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY pnu, administrative_district, issan, bon, bu, jimok_cd, jimok, area, land_move_reason_cd, land_move_reason, land_move_date , soyu_address, soyu_name, soyu_cd, soyu_gubun, soyu_trans_date, soyu_trans_reason_cd, soyu_trans_reason, sharing_num, pnilp, pnlip_susi, pnlip_1y_ago, pnlip_1y_ago_susi, pnlip_2y_ago, pnlip_2y_ago_susi, pnlip_3y_ago, pnlip_3y_ago_susi, pnlip_4y_ago, pnlip_4y_ago_susi,insert_date ORDER BY land_key) AS rows FROM land_info ) as T WHERE T.rows > 1 );

select layer_code from layermanager l where layer_cat = '주제도'

WITH select_jijuk AS ( SELECT geom FROM jijuk j WHERE pnu = #pnu# ), lt_c_data AS ( $query$ ) SELECT distinct lt.alias3 as alias, lt.remark, CASE WHEN ST_Within(lt.geom, sj.geom) THEN '포함' WHEN ST_Touches(sj.geom, lt.geom) THEN '접합' WHEN ST_Intersects(sj.geom, lt.geom) THEN '저촉' ELSE '무관' END AS relation_type FROM lt_c_data lt join select_jijuk sj on ST_Intersects(lt.geom, sj.geom) WHERE lt.alias3 is not null and lt.alias3 != '' ORDER BY alias
